tldr: 台股週五收漲156點至39,308點，台積電反彈1.63%，假期量能清淡、週線收紅。
輝達暫停對東南亞四國出貨AI伺服器，台股半導體設備股則因獲利了結回檔。
金管會要求金融業年底前完成資安自評，並調高融券保證金成數以穩定市場。

items.title_zh: 台股翻紅收漲156點、守穩39,000點，台積電領軍
items.title_en: Taiex ends up 156 points, holds above 39,000 as TSMC rebounds
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週五收在39,308.08點，上漲156.27點（0.40%）。早盤一度跌破38,900點後反彈，權值王台積電上漲1.63%、收2,180元，尾盤拉抬帶動指數翻紅。美股因感恩節休市、外資休假，全場成交量能明顯偏低。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark Taiex closed Friday at 39,308.08, up 156.27 points (0.40%), clawing back from an early dip below 38,900. TSMC rose 1.63% to NT$2,180, lifting the index late in a thin session with U.S. markets shut for Thanksgiving.

items.title_zh: 外資賣超縮至296億、投信買超85億，量縮週線收紅
items.title_en: Foreign selling narrows and local funds buy as turnover thins
items.summary_zh: 受假期影響，全日成交值量縮至約6,660億元。外資及陸資賣超縮小至296.28億元，投信則買超85.19億元，顯示內資承接力道。儘管量能清淡，加權指數週線仍收紅，主要受惠AI權值股回穩。
items.summary_en: Trading value shrank to about NT$666 billion in the holiday-thinned session. Foreign and mainland investors cut net selling to NT$29.63 billion, while domestic investment trusts bought a net NT$8.52 billion. The Taiex still finished the week higher, supported by a rebound in AI-related heavyweights.

items.title_zh: 輝達暫停對東南亞4國AI伺服器出貨，供應鏈恐受波及
items.title_en: Nvidia halts AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian nations
items.summary_zh: 外電報導，輝達已通知戴爾、美超微等伺服器廠，暫停對新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國、印尼出貨AI伺服器，恢復時間未定，被視為美方防堵中國取得AI算力的最新動作。此舉可能衝擊相關供應鏈出貨節奏與東南亞客戶布局。
items.summary_en: Nvidia has told server makers including Dell and Supermicro to suspend shipments of AI servers to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia, with no restart date, as Washington tightens curbs aimed at stopping China accessing AI compute. The move could ripple through supply chains and regional customers.

items.title_zh: 半導體設備股盤中重挫3.44%，資金短線調節
items.title_en: Chip-equipment stocks tumble as traders book profits
items.summary_zh: 週五盤中半導體設備族群一度重挫約3.44%，部分高價強勢股遭獲利了結，拖累類股表現，但大盤仍收紅。法人認為此為短線籌碼調節，AI晶片與CoWoS先進封裝的長線需求結構依舊強勁，中長期展望不變。
items.summary_en: Semiconductor-equipment names fell about 3.44% intraday Friday as investors trimmed high-priced winners, pressuring the sub-sector even as the broader index recovered. Analysts said the pullback was short-term positioning, with structural demand for AI chips and CoWoS advanced packaging still firm.

items.title_zh: 金管會要求金融業年底前完成14項資安自評並提報董事會
items.title_en: FSC orders banks and insurers to self-assess cyber resilience by year-end
items.summary_zh: 金管會於11月26日發布「金融業資安防護強化措施」，要求各金融機構在今年底前完成14項資安自評事項，並提報最近一次董事會審議。此舉旨在強化金融體系數位防護韌性，督促業者將資安治理提升至董事會層級。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission on Nov. 26 unveiled measures requiring financial institutions to complete 14 cybersecurity self-assessment items and report them to their boards before the end of 2026, part of a push to harden the sector's digital defenses and lift cyber governance to board level.

items.title_zh: 金管會祭穩定市場措施，融券保證金成數調高至150%
items.title_en: Regulator tightens short-selling rules to steady the market
items.summary_zh: 因應台股波動加劇，金管會陸續推出穩定市場措施，包括「全面禁止平盤以下放空」，並自11月23日起將上市櫃有價證券最低融券保證金成數調高至150%，先前亦調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量。金管會呼籲投資人理性因應。
items.summary_en: Amid elevated volatility, the FSC rolled out market-stabilization steps, barring short sales below the prior close and raising the minimum margin ratio for short selling on listed securities to 150% (effective Nov. 23), after earlier cutting intraday securities-lending sell quotas. Officials urged investors to stay rational.

items.title_zh: 中信銀個人信託服務升級，可配置境內ETF
items.title_en: CTBC Bank expands personal trusts to include domestic ETFs
items.summary_zh: 中國信託銀行全面升級個人信託服務，將原本以境內外基金、債券為主的可運用標的，進一步擴充納入境內ETF。此舉讓高資產與傳承規劃客戶能在信託架構下更靈活布局ETF部位，深化財富管理與資產傳承的商品彈性。
items.summary_en: CTBC Bank has upgraded its personal trust service, broadening eligible assets from mainly onshore and offshore funds and bonds to include domestically listed ETFs. The change gives high-net-worth and legacy-planning clients more flexibility to build ETF positions within a trust structure.

items.title_zh: 主動式ETF密集獲准成立，財管商品線再擴充
items.title_en: Wave of actively managed ETFs wins approval
items.summary_zh: 10月至11月間，多檔主動式ETF陸續獲准成立，包括復華台灣新星主動式ETF（00418A）於11月3日核准成立，以及其他多檔主動式產品。新品接連問世，為財富管理客戶提供更多主動管理、可在交易所買賣的投資選擇。
items.summary_en: A string of actively managed ETFs gained regulatory approval through October and November, including Fuh Hwa's Taiwan New Star Active ETF (00418A), approved on Nov. 3, alongside several other active products. The launches widen the menu for wealth-management clients seeking actively managed, exchange-traded exposure.
